title: The Thursday Murder Club
author: Richard Osman
summary: Four sharp retirees in a comfortable English village meet each week to look into old, unsolved killings. When a real murder happens on their doorstep, they find themselves with a live case.
readIf: you like warm, witty mysteries with older heroes and a lot of charm.
skipIf: you want a hard-boiled or very suspenseful crime novel, since the tone is gentle and the plot deliberately cosy.

pairings.reason: The classic that this style of puzzle mystery grew out of, with a polished closed-circle case.
Another warm, funny story of older people and the neighbours who gradually pull them back into life.
A cosy village mystery with a thoughtful investigator and a deep sense of community.
